positions.as_written: Use thin coronal and axial images through the fibular styloid.
Trace it from the popliteus tendon towards the styloid.
Accept that it may not be identifiable, and say so rather than omitting it.
Assess the fibular styloid for avulsion, which reports the ligament indirectly.
Assess the rest of the corner, since this ligament rarely fails alone.
